Why America’s Top Scientists Are Going Missing [They Knew Too Much…] https://youtu.be/wlsQIbpEKSM

Here are the facts about “The Missing Scientists” story: The Air Force general who ran Wright-Patterson's research lab, oversaw the Pentagon's most classified programs, and was named in WikiLeaks emails as a central figure in UFO disclosure vanished from his Albuquerque home without triggering a single surveillance camera. Eight days earlier, Trump ordered the Pentagon to begin releasing UFO files. In the same twelve-month window, the NASA scientist who co-invented a strategic rocket engine super alloy at the same Wright Patterson lab overseen by the General disappeared on a hike, an MIT fusion physicist (who was as deep as anybody on “fast magnetic reconnection problems” which are the fundamental bottleneck to widescale nuclear fusion) was assassinated on his doorstep, and a very-polymathic Caltech astronomer working on the state-of-the-art Vera Rubin Observatory was shot dead on his porch. There is a pattern: scientists at the frontier of fusion, exotic propulsion, advanced metallurgy, and space surveillance are being silenced and taken out. We trace this history back decades and place it in its proper context: scientific suppression in frontier areas isn’t new; it’s an almost-ubiquitous historical artifact.

Whoops Cursor - from Gemini.

https://venturebeat.com/technology/cursors-composer-2-was-secretly-built-on-a-chinese-ai-model-and-it-exposes-a

--

The AI system making headlines today is Composer 2, a newly launched coding model by the San Francisco-based AI startup Cursor.

Here is a breakdown of what happened:

The Accidental Output: Shortly after Cursor launched Composer 2—marketing it as a proprietary, "frontier-level" coding model—a developer inspecting the platform's API responses discovered a hidden internal model ID string that read kimi-k2p5-rl-0317-s515-fast.

The Chinese Origin: That string revealed that Composer 2 was secretly built on top of Kimi K2.5, an open-source model developed by Moonshot AI (a prominent Chinese AI startup backed by Alibaba and Tencent).

The Admission: Following the exposure on X (formerly Twitter) and Reddit, Cursor's leadership publicly confirmed the discovery. Co-founder Aman Sanger admitted it was a "miss" not to disclose the Kimi foundation in their initial launch announcement.

The Defense: Cursor clarified that while Kimi K2.5 served as the base, only about 25% of the final model's computing power came from it. The remaining 75% was dedicated to Cursor's own rigorous reinforcement learning and fine-tuning specifically for coding tasks. Moonshot AI also weighed in, confirming that Cursor's commercial use of the model was fully authorized through a partnership with the inference platform Fireworks AI.

The incident has sparked heavy debate in the tech community regarding transparency and the heavy reliance of Western AI startups on Chinese open-source models.

author: Clara Sophia
work:
Lately, I've been reflecting on how so many, as they get older, are holding back.
Not allowing themselves to daydream anymore.

My new song 'Quiet Dreams' was inspired by that.

This song is an invitation to imagine freely, to feel deeply, and keep believing in something soft and beautiful ahead.


Listen to it here: http://ffm.to/quiet-dreams

If you’ve ever been told your dreams are too much, too big, too different…
please don’t stop.

I really believe the dreams we carry aren’t random.
If you can feel it in your heart, there’s a path where it can become real.

Every single part of my reality that i'm now so grateful for, was born through daydreaming and strong imagination.

I hope this becomes a restful space for you…
to slow down, breathe, and let your imagination wander again 🌙

I'm curious..

Have you already listened to it?
And how does it make you feel? 
✨ Let me know in the comments!

author: Clara Sophia
work:
As you all know, the past few weeks I’ve felt slower and more tender.
More tired than usual. A little overwhelmed. Wanting more space, more quiet, more time to just be.
And from your messages, I know many of you are feeling it too 🤍

With this full moon + eclipse energy, things can feel amplified. Not always in big dramatic ways, sometimes it’s just your body asking you to pause.

And honestly, with everything happening in the world right now… so much darkness coming to light… it’s natural that sensitive, empathetic souls feel it deeply.

So if you’re feeling heavier or more inward lately, it doesn’t mean something is wrong.
Every transformation has a cocoon phase.
A darker phase.
A moment where you pull back before something new can emerge.

Let yourself take space.
Let yourself realign.
Come back to what feels true for you.

And I want to share something special with you..

This Thursday, I’m releasing a new sound healing journey, with this beautiful soul radiating his love through the screen. 🥰
It felt deeply healing for me while creating it and I'm excited to be back.

Take gentle care of yourselves. I’m so grateful we’re walking this path together. 🤍

If you want to know my stance on AI, this picture says it all. ⁣
⁣
I see so many, but more so men, supporting this venture, which goes to show how the unconscious masculine mind is still warped by technology and the idea that artificial tech can replace intuitive emotional intelligence.⁣
⁣
It fucking can’t. ⁣
⁣
If you haven't noticed yet, there is a division of timelines playing out that we must actively choose: ⁣
⁣
The transhuman (closed heart) versus the organic human (open heart). ⁣
⁣
Some of us are creating a clear, conscious connection with Source Light Intelligence, while others are relying on artificial, manufactured technologies to try to pseudo-create that connection. ⁣
⁣
(Bee-Boo-Beep!) 🤖⁣
⁣
Of course, we have been warned of this prophecy since ancient times, and now it is manifesting and unfolding for us to witness and actively choose our stance and our devotion.⁣
⁣
Therefore, our energy is either supporting the old, toxic, masculine energy of conquer, consume, and dominate. 🤮⁣
⁣
Or the Divine Feminine energy, which is rooted in heart-centered love, community, nature, and emotional/intuitive intelligence. 🌸⁣
⁣
Brothers and sisters, now more than ever, do we need the true poets, artists, and raw-doggers to come forth and share their organic, intuitive work straight from the Cosmic Mind/Heart!⁣
⁣
No more hiding your sacred light or beauty! ⁣
⁣
We need your organic expression! ⁣
⁣
Because I don't know about you, but I am here for the nipples in the sunshine while dancing barefoot in the grass, sipping Kombucha experience.⁣
⁣
Join me in this authenticity?⁣
⁣
⁣
XO,⁣
Anna⁣

Why do you do what you do? What makes you get out of bed in the morning?⁣
⁣
If we don’t have a WHY, we will always stumble back into the darkness and only live for petty reasons. ⁣
⁣
My WHY is my children and my children's children. As many of you know, I am a mom of two with a third one on the way in April! And it's my honor and joy to leave them a legacy of love and wisdom that they can embody, shine, and pass down to their family. Openly sharing our Timeless Wisdom is how we create a new species and a new culture. We hand down what's of true importance—⁣
⁣
The teachings of conscious love, joy, and Presence! ⁣
⁣
For we are all a family of light pretending we are not. ⁣
⁣
What a dream to awaken from!⁣
⁣
So, what's your WHY? ⁣
⁣
I'd love to know what gets your heart drumming for creation—for your family!⁣

XO,⁣
Anna (and Lila)! ⁣

author: Mind-Body Solution
work:
What if neurons aren’t the foundation of mind?

In this Mind-Body Solution Colloquia, Michael Levin and Robert Chis-Ciure challenge one of neuroscience’s deepest assumptions: that cognition and intelligence are exclusive to brains and neurons.

Drawing on cutting-edge work in bioelectricity, developmental biology, and philosophy of mind, this conversation explores how cells, tissues, and living systems exhibit goal-directed behavior, memory, and problem-solving — long before neurons ever appear.

We explore:
• Cognition without neurons
• Bioelectric networks as control systems
• Memory and learning beyond synapses
• Morphogenesis as collective intelligence
• Implications for AI, consciousness, and ethics

This episode pushes neuroscience beyond the neuron, toward a deeper understanding of mind, life, and intelligence as continuous across scales.

author: Steve Nobel
work:
The energy of Kali Ma is very much needed in the world right now. Transmission will soon be coming!

Kali Ma is a major goddess in Hinduism, primarily associated with time, death, and destruction.

Kali is also connected with transcendental knowledge and is one of a number of goddesses who provide liberating knowledge.

She is chiefly worshipped as the Divine Mother, Mother of the Universe, and Divine feminine energy.

The origins of Kali can be traced to the pre-Vedic and Vedic era goddess worship traditions in the Indian subcontinent.

Kali appears in many stories, with the most popular one being when she manifests as personification of goddess Durga to defeat a demon.

Her appearance can be purposefully shocking, as she comes to disrupt and destroy what needs to be disrupted and destroyed at a personal and planetary level.

Rough love is certainly her way to help you discover your wisdom and your power.

work:
Beautiful soul family,
As we gently arrive into 2026, we are so happy to share a new song with you.
"Open Portal" is now out on all streaming platforms.
Listen to it here: https://ffm.to/open-portal

This piece is an invitation to slow down, soften, and listen inward - giving you space for reflection & intention setting for this new cycle to come.

As we look back at 2025, we are so deeply grateful for each and every one of you.
Thank you for tuning into our music and for sharing how it touches you.
Thank you to my Voice Revelation Community for trusting me to guide you into opening your voices.
Thank you for your love, support and kindness.

We can't wait to see many of you in person next year, as we finally come to tour in Europe.
There's many more new projects, music and opportunities to connect more personally coming up in 2026, so stay tuned! ✨

We are curious to hear..
What's your intention for this new year?
👇🏼 Let us know in the comments and let's inspire each other!

author: Brian Scott
work:
Who are you?

Most people, when they answer that question, give a description of their current circumstances. I am a mother. I am an accountant. I am someone who struggles with confidence. I am someone who is working on their health. I am someone who has always had trouble with money. These answers feel true because they match our current experience. But they are not who we are. They are one configuration of who we are — one expression among infinite expressions.


I want to share my own experience with this because I am not teaching theory. I am teaching what I have lived.


When I decided to write my first book, I faced a problem. I was not a writer. I had never written anything substantial. The task seemed overwhelming. But I knew about the infinite selves. I knew that somewhere in the probability field, there existed a version of me who was a masterful writer — someone who had spent decades honing the craft, who could organize ideas beautifully, who could translate consciousness into language.


So I accessed that version. I reached across the dimensional barrier and connected with the writer version of myself. I did not ask for tips. I did not request advice. I merged with him. I allowed his consciousness to overlap with mine. And when I came out of that state, the book that had seemed impossible began to flow. It was as if I was remembering how to write rather than learning for the first time.


But here is where it gets even more interesting. One morning, I woke up with an overwhelming urge to paint. Now understand — I had never touched a paintbrush. I had no artistic training whatsoever. But the urge was undeniable. And I realized what had happened. In my explorations of the infinite selves, I had contacted the version of me who was a lifelong artist. Some of his consciousness had integrated into mine. His passion, his vision, his way of seeing — it had become available to me. I began painting, and what emerged was not the work of a beginner.


More recently, I accessed the version of myself who is the greatest musician. And now I am creating music — producing an album, writing songs that I never could have imagined creating from my ordinary limited identity.


This is real. This works. And you are about to experience it for yourself.


https://youtu.be/zY2Ijl5Aipk

author: Clara Sophia
work:
Beautiful beings,
Lately, I’ve been in this deep space of transformation. Like something new is knocking on the door of my life, wanting to be born.
In my personal world, in my music, in the way I express myself.
It feels like I'm slowly becoming a different version of me.
It feels liberating, terrifying, and so deeply right – all at once.

My new song – Werewolf – feels like the beginning of that shift. Like it carries the exact energy of what’s unfolding inside of me.
Even though I wrote it years ago (funny how that always happens), somehow it’s perfectly aligned with what I’m living right now. And I know some of you are feeling that too, because you’ve told me.

Werewolf is about breaking free from old versions of ourselves. Letting go of what others expect of us.
It’s a song about choosing your own path – even if it scares you. Even if it doesn’t make sense to anyone else.

Right now, the lyrics of this song are helping me remember who I am. They're helping me trust my heart and move towards the unknown, one step at a time. And I hope they do that for you too.
I’ll share more soon about what’s been shifting in my world. But for now… maybe you can already feel it when you listen to Werewolf. 🦋

If you’ve already listened…
In just one word – how did it make you feel?
👇🏼 Let me know in the comments!

Thanks for being here.
Thanks for letting me grow in front of you.

So much love,
Clara Sophia

author: Goju Tech Talk
work:
Hi GTTers -

First, thanks for all of your support! We're building an amazing community and I'm happy beyond what words can express. I feel very blessed to be part of this amazing "GTT movement" that it seems like we're building. Wowowow!

Second, starting immediately, we are going to "cut up" all future GTT episodes into ~40min segments, even if this means a given episode may be broken into multiple 40min segments (e.g., the Windsurf episode is being broken into two parts). So you may start to see things like this:

- "what is going on with Windsurf (1/N, 40min)"
- "what is going on with Windsurf (2/N, 40min)"
- "what is going on with Windsurf (3/3, end)"

(or something like this)

This will likely give you a hint into what's going on if you see these things. :)

The *REASON* for this is YouTube seems to auto-dub and auto-subtitle our GTT VODs to ~15 languages *BUT ONLY IF* the videos are ~40mins or less. Given that at least 70% of our viewers are non-native English speakers, who use auto-dubbing and auto-subtitles for their main language, leveraging YouTube's auto-dubbing and auto-subtitling is a major boon to us getting our content to these folks. 

As such, our effort to split episodes into 40min or less parts is likely to positively help a large majority of GTTers as well as providing them with content that they can access as easily as native English speakers can access GTT content.

That's all for now. Thank you all for helping build such an amazing community. I'm thrilled to have each and every one of you traveling with us on the GTT journey!

Goju <3

So if the goal of the evil is to veil and deny our divinity, when we live the best versions of ourselves, we have triumphed without fighting.”

-Gregg Braden-

When I heard Gregg Braden say this on our latest interview, something clicked deep inside me. We’re not here to fight darkness, we're here to be light. To live so fully in our truth, in our divinity, that there’s no space left for illusion. This is how we triumph. Not by waging a war… But by remembering who we are.

author: Clara Sophia
work:
“Werewolf” is finally out in the world!
https://youtu.be/6uqP_j2l_DA

And honestly… I don’t even know how to begin describing what this song means to me.
It’s the most personal thing I’ve ever written.
It came from a moment I didn’t see coming, one that completely cracked me open.

👉 If “Werewolf” touches you, please give it a like and share it with your loved ones, so I can spread this message even more into this world. 🤍

At its core, it’s about purpose. The fear, the doubt, the growth, and all the ways we hold ourselves back. That’s what I thought it was about when I wrote it.
And it is.
But only later did I realize there was something even deeper woven into it. Something I couldn’t see at the time.
Like a message from my future self.
The full story revealed itself in a way I never expected and it was so emotional for me that up until this day it’s hard for me to sing this song until the end without bursting into tears.
If you watch until the very end, you’ll understand.
This song cracked me open. It helped me go through a time of grief and self-doubt and I hope it can help you too.

author: Malte Marten
work:
A little life update.
I'm now back home from my tour and it feels really good to be back. To get some rest, to be with my two sons and to spend some quiet moments with my partner. 
The tour itself was really wonderful, so many of you were there and it was such a pleasure to meet the Handpan family in different places around the world. Many of the concerts were unforgettable experiences and I am very grateful for all the moments I shared with you. Thanks to each and every one of you for being there!
On the other hand, the tour was also extremely exhausting for me and pushed me to my physical and emotional limits. I also realized that cities just aren't my thing anymore. Growing up in Berlin, fully immersed into the urban energy, I experienced all I needed to experience being in a big city. Now I am longing for nature, for calmness, for silence, for solitude and for simplicity. The consumerism, the noise, the overall distortion when being in a city exhausts me. I appreciate its beautiful diversity and cultural & social variety, yet I feel drawn to the trees and birds, to the rocks and deers. I'll see where it all takes me, but for now I'm going to enjoy the quiet moments at home in the beauty of the Black Forest.

And to share one of the proudest moments of my life with you, the Golden Play Button from YouTube arrived. I still can't believe how many people listen to my music with an open heart. Once again, thank you from the bottom of my heart for everything 🤍

Imagine if during your day you just sat for 10 minutes, once a day, and said to yourself:

"I allow myself to feel everything. I allow myself to release everything. I allow myself to become who I am here to be."

Your world would change. Your world begins inside the soul, yet so many of you have been taught it is the other way around. Imagine if you sat for 10 minutes and just allowed everything to move through you and invited your soul to be with you.

"I invite my soul to be fully present in me now. I invite my soul to be fully present in me now. I invite my soul to be fully present in me now."

For many of you, you will feel a heart expansion, a mental softening, an exhale moving through your body and your spirit. You are here dear ones, on Earth, alive, right now. You are listening to this from your alive human body and your planet is highly electrically charged right now. And we are not referring to electricity or technology here. Your planet is highly electrically charged so transformation is faster than ever before.

work:
Public Statement Regarding Liron Shapira

After careful consideration, I've decided to publicly clarify my position regarding interactions with Liron Shapira, particularly our recent conversation.

Liron Shapira approached me repeatedly, requesting a debate. Initially, I was open to this idea, provided he engaged with my written works and offered an apology for his previous disrespectful remarks (including explicitly calling me a "coward" on his YouTube channel, as reported by multiple individuals).

In our most recent conversation, Liron repeatedly demonstrated behaviors consistent with evasion, manipulation, and goalpost-moving:

1. Denial and Backpedaling: Initially, he denied ever stating that humanity was "dead no matter what." When I confronted him with evidence (screenshots and multiple audience confirmations), he quickly shifted his stance, claiming he meant we were "likely doomed," aligning himself retroactively with probabilistic doom scenarios. This rapid pivoting constitutes explicit backpedaling when confronted with evidence.

2. Continuous Dodging of Simple Conditions: When explicitly asked if he would read my book (a common courtesy and a basic prerequisite for informed debate), he avoided committing clearly, introducing conditions such as insisting on an exchange of equal time. When asked directly about substantial contributions from his side (research, books, or code), he evaded specificity and referred me broadly to his YouTube channel instead.

3. Refusal to Apologize for Unprofessional Conduct: When directly confronted with his name-calling behavior (explicitly calling me a coward on his YouTube channel), he tacitly conceded to this but dismissed any responsibility, stating, "I don't see my behavior as inappropriate, so I will not apologize."

4. Manipulative Tactics and Attempts at Control: Liron repeatedly shifted the debate focus, suggesting alternative topics (such as analyzing a specific paper) rather than addressing my clear, initial conditions. This consistent behavior further confirmed my suspicion that he simply wanted to evade accountability.

Given these circumstances, and after consulting closely with my inner circle—who unanimously described Liron as a troll and a bully—I have decided to disengage completely. I maintain a zero-tolerance policy toward bullying, disrespect, and manipulative behavior.

Therefore, effective immediately, I have blocked Liron Shapira and will not entertain future interactions or debates with him. I firmly believe rewarding such conduct by providing a platform or my time would perpetuate toxic behavior, which I unequivocally refuse to support. Actions have consequences. 

I remain committed to productive and respectful discussions on AI alignment with anyone sincerely interested in meaningful dialogue.

PS, I do have the receipts but I won't stoop so low as to publicly post private chats. I am, however, done with this fool.

work:
🚨Former Presidential Advisor Reveals He Directly Handled UFO Material🚨https://youtu.be/09KP8XVf5nY

A 27 year old Harald Malmgren literally saved the world from nuclear catastrophe during The Cuban Missile Crisis when Secretary of Defense Robert McNamara and President JFK asked him to “buy time for diplomacy” by facing off against General Curtis “Bombs Away” LeMay. Malmgren, the youngest of the “whiz kids”, went on to become a presidential advisor not just to JFK, but LBJ, Nixon and Ford. He had a personal relationship with Putin and advised every Japanese Prime Minister since Tanaka in the 70’s, Giscard d’Estaing, Pompidou and others.  He was assigned to “contain” Kissinger and worked closely with Howard Baker, George Schulz, Volcker and Mondale not to mention Nobel Prize winners Tom Schelling and Sir John Hicks. Unusually, he had ALL the so called Q Clearances. His credentials are unimpeachable. 

So it should make everyone question their reality when this man, at the end of his life and before tragically passing, felt compelled to pass on what he learned to humanity: earth-shattering revelations. He claimed these things in a 4 hour interview: 

1. He held UFO (or UAP) material directly. This material came out of the plume of a nuclear test called Bluegill Triple Prime conducted at Johnston Atoll in the Marshall Islands in 1962. It was handed to him by Lawrence Preston Gise, director of the Albuquerque branch of the Atomic Energy Commission (who happens to be Jeff Bezos’ grandfather). 

2. The Deputy Director of Plans for the CIA and the man who built and designed Area51, Richard Bissell, briefed Malmgren on “otherworld technologies”. This includes past crash retrievals like the Magenta crash in Lombardy, Italy in 1933 along with broader awareness of UFO appearances around tip of the spear technology development at sensitive Department of Energy sites across the country. 

3. That a member of foreign intelligence sent Harald information on a secret antigravity-related collaboration between Tesla and Thomas Townsend Brown. 

4. He told his daughter Pippa off air in his final hours that there had been UFO crash survivors (biologics) and he was shown a video of the “sole surviving extraterrestrial being” from one such crash (Roswell). 

5. Malmgren says point blank that he believes JFK knew about UFOs long before becoming president (from his history in Naval Intelligence). He and LBJ raced out to Los Alamos right after Blugill Triple Prime to be briefed in person. He says that JFK’s desire to collaborate with the Soviets on UFOs, space exploration and denuclearization were core parts of the impetus to assassinate him. 

6. Malmgren discusses the “Majestic” - the group who took it upon themselves to “protect” the world. They tracked him from a young age, he says. This is the first time anyone of this caliber has mentioned this name which is mostly associated with document leaks in the 80’s and 90’s that outline an “elite of the elite” military, intelligence and scientific group governing the UFO issue.  

Harald is a hero who saved the world (and more than once). There was more he held back and that he took to his grave. He was an angel amongst devils and his legacy should make all world leaders think twice, reflect and “lower the temperature” on the world stage when contemplating brinksmanship. We barely scratched the surface on what he likely had to say and will have to mull this over for years. But it’s a quantum leap forward for disclosure and simply can’t be ignored by members of the mainstream media. 

We are extremely grateful to Harald’s incredible daughter Pippa Malmgren for co-hosting this discussion. She was Special Assistant to President Bush and a member of The National Economic Council and a very heterodox thinker in her own right. She teased the truth from her father and helped him come forward with his critically important insights. She set the whole discussion up and we’re forever indebted for her entrusting us to help tell Harald’s story. She said that Bissell told my Dad  - “because you’ll need to pass it along in the future at the right time”.  At 89, she knew her father in turn had to relay this vital information, this time, on a broader stage as our multipolar nuclear world remains stuck in old paradigms. Australian Intelligence Analyst Geoffrey Cruikshank, who has gone deeper than anyone in the world on analyzing the Bluegill Triple Prime Test UFO incident, also conferred with Harald Malmgren to confirm the veracity of his foundational research. His research was essential to this piece. Rest in peace Harald Bernard Malmgren (July 13th 1935 - February 13th 2025).

author: Steve Nobel
work:
Dear Starseed,

There is a rather common program that runs when we begin the path of spiritual awakening and growth.

This program could be called one step forward, stuff happens then one step back. 

This program could be called one step forward, stuff happens then one or more steps back. 

This can happen when the conscious mind desires forward movement yet the unconscious mind fears, and seeks the status quo, it for some reason.

To your conscious mind the status quo may feel undesirable, yet the unconscious may be running on the old maxim better the devil you know! 

Perhaps the root cause of the fear lies in conditioning in the formative years. Most commonly, around lack of love, lack of feeling worthy, deserving, fortunate enough, capable. 

Perhaps the root cause of the fear lies in imprints and programs that have their origin in other lifetimes. Typically, experiences of persecution, execution, torture, exile and the like! 

The good news is that all of this resistance is within you therefore it is within your power to transform it. 

There are so many techniques and modalities available these days. Also, on my website and YouTube channel I have hundreds of free tracks to assist.

Whatever you wish to be or do today I wish you freedom at every level of your being. The freedom to move forward anyway your heart desires.

Love Steve 🙏🌼🌸🎉☀️🌷🎉🎉🌼✨🌷☀️🎉✨🎉🌼🌸🎉✨🌷☀️🙏

author: Project Unity
work:
IMPORTANT: Addressing the 'Depth Measurement Issue' with the New Findings at Giza Plateau  

"Critics on social media question how Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) scans of the Giza pyramids, using satellite radar beams, can detect voids 2 km underground or chambers behind walls, assuming radar can’t penetrate deeply. However, this skepticism misunderstands Filippo Biondi’s method. 

Unlike Ground Penetrating Radar, Biondi’s SAR technique uses X-band microwaves (10 GHz, 3 cm wavelength) that barely penetrate the ground (less than 30 cm). Instead, it detects subtle surface movements—shivers—caused by resonating voids deep underground or behind walls. 

These shivers, akin to seismic waves, create a Doppler effect that SAR measures with high resolution in distance, direction, and frequency shift. Biondi analyzes these patterns across pixel lines (tomograms) to pinpoint the voids’ locations, tracing the mechanical surface effects back to their subterranean sources."

work:
We are so excited to share our new song with you! 😍
>> Listen to ‘Whispers of Starlight’ here:
https://ffm.to/qypnzxr

Beautiful beings, we hope you’re all doing well. 
Our past weeks have been filled with beautiful nature places, lots of music, and creative processes.
And we are so grateful to share this new song with you today!
‘Whispers of Starlight’ is a song that emerged in a musical collaboration with our dear friend and talented musician playing the guitar with our soundscapes.
It was such a magical moment.. ✨✨
This song brings beautiful and wise messages from the stars onto this earth, through healing sounds and vibrations. 🪽
In times like these, where the world seems to become a very chaotic place that is moving so fast, we feel it’s so important to find ways to stay grounded and connect to the wisdom that us hidden within our hearts.
We hope you can feel this message resonating deeply within you and find a safe space for you to rest in with these soundscapes..

With so much love,
Clara & Yuval 🤍

author: David Shapiro
work:
Late nights have me thinking about identity and AI lately. I've realized that just like some people develop a "beauty complex," I've had a lifelong "genius complex." My intelligence defined me - from impressing adults as a kid to building complex automation systems at Cisco. But now AI is sailing past human capabilities in coding, math, and everything I once prided myself on.

The hard truth? Our traditional sources of self-worth are becoming obsolete. What happens when we become nobody? When GPT-5 becomes smarter than even Sam Altman this year, what makes any of us special anymore? These questions keep me up at night, wrestling with a future that's arriving faster than most realize.

Yet in this upheaval, I'm finding peace in simple moments - breakfast with my wife, watching our dogs play at the park, capturing the beauty of a river in fall. AI might overtake our skills, but it can't take away these pure human experiences. Maybe becoming nobody isn't my worst nightmare after all. Maybe it's liberation.

work:
There's much happening to draw our attention to energy and happenings that serve us well (as well as those that don't).


Focusing your energy is your choice and your power. 


The Angels guide us to: 

-Focus on gratitude (instead of fear)

-Focus on flow (instead of struggle)

-Focus on healing to hold more light (instead of worrying)

-Focus on your current situation in safety and wellness (instead of worrying about what could happen)

-Focus on what you can do (instead of what you can't do)

-Focus on community activities (instead of watching the news)

-Focus on releasing the energy of resentment and anger (instead of ruminating on what happened or wishing the past was different)

-Focus on preparing ahead to smooth out upcoming bumps (instead of focusing on fear)

-Focus on loving yourself fully (instead of wishing you were different)

-Focus on kindness (instead of criticism)

-Focus on what you already have or have accomplished (instead of what you haven't done yet)

-Focus on the much higher and wider spiritual view (instead of the in the weeds of pain human view)

-Focus on the beauty and joy that comes next (instead of limiting your experiences by trying to determine exactly what New Earth will be like) 


Implementation ideas:

-Focus on each guidance point for a day, a week, or even a month

-Create sticky notes with reminders to yourself

-Raise your by smiling and focusing on what you're grateful for - then ask your spiritual team (aloud) for an Angel who specializes in a specific focus point to guide and help you

-Post in the Spirit Means Business Facebook group to share you're making this commitment to yourself

-Meet up in-person or online with others sharing your goals to provide support and gentle accountability

-Journal about your implementation experience; be sure to center yourself and connect with your spiritual team before you write

-Gather your water filter (to eliminate viruses and bacteria without boiling), some extra food, and supplies so you know you're covered for the bumps. 

-Spend your time with those who support your self-healing efforts

-Participate in a healing practice you feel aligned with the intent to shift your focus and release all that no longer serves you. 


Celebrate your successes!

author: Esoteric Atlanta
work:
You guys!!!! I am floored by all the reviews Paula and I have gotten over The Esoteric Academy! 😭😭😭 Your reviews mean the world to me. THIS WORK means the world to me. THANK YOU, THANK YOU, THANK YOU! I know I create hard workouts, but I am TICKLED by all the reviews of how fun they are too!!!  THAT IS MY PLAN. Just because something is hard doesn’t mean it can’t also be fun!!! 🤩 Every thing in life that is worthwhile, is hard. Everything in life that is hard builds the soul.  And guess what! YOU ARE WORTH DOING HARD THINGS!!!! You’re worth it. Every time you get on your mat, every time you lace up that running shoe, every time you pull that ballet barre out… you are worth it. You’re worth the sweat, you’re worth the soreness, you’re worth the discomfort.

I am also SO EXCITED that a few of you have told me (literally two in one day- there must be something in the air) that your teenage daughters are JOINING YOU AND HAVING FUN!!! To get a compliment from a TEENAGE GIRL is literally the same as winning an Oscar. 🤣 

To the teenage girls working out with your mamas… baby girls, YOU CAN DO HARD THINGS. And baby girls, you are WORTH it. I’m so glad you’re learning at a young age that exercise is not about punishing your body, but rather, it’s a way to activate your body, your chakras, your soul. It’s a way to cleanse yourself, renew your soul, and find out just how strong you are.  

With that being said, I hear y’all (the teenage girls)  really like the Fusion classes (me too😜). So for the teenage girls, their mamas, and every single soul in the academy, I am creating a 75 minute fusion class with all the hits. I’ve got music from the adults generation and yours (the teenagers). 

It’ll be shot next week!!! 

Please don’t hesitate to make request! I love that y’all are loving it and I will do everything in my power to serve you to my best ability as a professional spiritual ass kicker!!! 

I also cannot wait to start our live classes and weekly calls. 

For those who want to join in the fun, check us out at www.theesotericacademy.com

author: Emilio Ortiz
work:
A recent photograph captured at Dr. Joe Dispenza’s retreat. 

The act of holding my hand over my heart has gained tremendous significance to me in the last few years. 

Whenever a storms comes through my world, I know that in this space of zero point neutrality, all problems fade away. There’s no more fear. No more struggle. No more chaos. 

As we enter a new year, I want to take a moment to acknowledge this beautiful heart centered community.

We started off 2024 with 20,000 people subscribed to this channel and we have grown in leaps and bounds. 

What this means is that more and more people are beginning to ask questions beyond themselves and are curious to understand the layers deep within themselves. 

I can already feel how much of a quantum leap 2025 will be for all of us. World events will reveal new truths; new voices and ideas will be heard. Mysteries will be remembered. Dormant potentials within us will be reawakened. 

There is nothing that I’m more excited about than the unfolding story of humanity. 

It’s a blessing to be part of this moment in history that the future generations will look back upon. 

We are all a monumental seed in this new story. 

Thank you for coming together, with your minds open and your hearts open. 

Thank you for trusting in me.

Thank you for taking this journey.

All our higher selves are so proud of us. 

We are only getting started 🚀

I love you all with my all my heart ✨🫂❤️‍🔥

work:
I know you’ve been waiting for this moment to come..
We are finally back here on YouTube!! 😍✨
Tomorrow a new video is coming out and we’re so excited to connect with you all again on here!
These past weeks have been very busy for us.

We finalised many of our projects and can’t wait to share more about them soon with you!
One very exciting thing that happened, is that we played a beautiful live show in a festival, with some of our unreleased songs and received amazing feedback!
We absolutely loved being on stage again and meeting some of you in real life. 🤍

We can’t wait for our Europe tour next summer!!
We’re curious..
Who will be in Europe summer 2025??
We want to connect with as many of you as possible and share our music in person with you. 🤗

Ps: Slide to the right to see some snippets of our performance ✨
